name: Amazon Ancient Ruins
notes: V0.6.0 changes the workflow from page-at-a-time exactification to a 420-slot full-set solver aimed at the entire remaining inventory in one phase.
The branch has advanced from 51 to 61 instruction-exact transforms using only manual-corroborated unique groups, exact-anchor neighborhoods and corrected existing inventory occurrences.

Page 22 now adds the Yellow 4032 pulley, Blue 3700 crank connector, unique Dark Gray 30156pb01 printed tower facade, unique Blue 3009 brick, White 3937 / Yellow 3938 hinge pair and Black 3176 plate-with-hole around the already exact chain mechanism.
The White 3937 and Yellow 3938 were not duplicated: the solver corrected their previous trapdoor-proxy placement and relocated those same inventory occurrences to the page-22 tower mechanism.
Manual page 4 now contributes the complete three-part crocodile: Green 6026 body, 6027 upper jaw and 6028 tail, each a unique inventory occurrence with a unique LDD record.

The solver classifies every inventory occurrence as already exact, geometry-ready but page-blocked, CAD variant/overflow ambiguous, CAD shortfall, or no CAD match; CAD alone is never allowed to promote exact coverage.
The solver withholds occurrence-level LDD refs for interchangeable groups whenever an exact peer lacks a claimed CAD record, preventing arbitrary duplicate ordering from becoming false identity.
The first generated 420-slot solver audit has not yet landed from the branch Actions job, so no bulk CAD-only promotions are being counted prematurely.
The page-24 3308 false lead remains quarantined: LDD ref 446 belongs to the page-30 gate-web-arch.
Two old Light Gray 6081 roof shapes remain visual-only placeholders and are excluded from the 420-part ledger.
World-space convention: one unit equals one LEGO stud pitch.
